prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one compact flat diagonal skeletal-rig layer
Primary request: Draw exactly one straight connected tapered rounded panel from upper-left to lower-right. The upper end is solid and slightly wider; the lower end is solid and narrower. Keep one straight centerline.
Color sequence: pale muted-peach upper section; narrow deep-navy band with one tiny dull-gold four-point mark; long light lavender-gray section #B4B7C4; one hard slate-lavender shadow strip #8D91AA; short solid lower overlap in the same light lavender gray.
Rendering: closed flat-color fills with hard boundaries and one thin slate-gray contour. Every mark is confined to this one connected component.
Composition/framing: exactly one complete component centered and uncropped on a vertical 2:3 canvas, occupying about 12 percent of width and 35 percent of height, with very broad unused margins.
Constraints: one component and one view only; no pair, duplicate, detached cap, hollow end, opening, bend, extra appendage, full character, other garment, detached mark, prop, stand, floor, scenery, text, logo, signature, watermark, sprite sheet, atlas, turnaround, panel grid, or inset.
